physical_audio.description: Real hardware microphone capture across physical USB and analog inputs
physical_audio.deterministic_seam: Virtual audio loopback (WASAPI on Windows, BlackHole on macOS, PulseAudio null sink on Linux)
physical_audio.validation_criteria: 16kHz 16-bit mono stream delivers without underrun or sample clipping

sleep_resume.description: System ACPI suspend-to-RAM / sleep while listening or transcribing, followed by wake
sleep_resume.deterministic_seam: Power event injection seam triggering suspend notification, timer pause, and wake watchdog
sleep_resume.validation_criteria: Active listening session cancels immediately on sleep; wake restores ready state and re-verifies STT engine health

bluetooth_headset.description: Bluetooth device connection/disconnection and profile transition (A2DP wideband to HFP telephony 16kHz/8kHz)
bluetooth_headset.deterministic_seam: Virtual Bluetooth endpoint simulator injecting device arrival/removal and sample rate reconfiguration events
bluetooth_headset.validation_criteria: Audio pipeline automatically re-samples to 16kHz without buffer overflow or pipeline panic

display_dpi_scaling.description: Dynamic display DPI scale changes (100%, 125%, 150%, 200%) and multi-monitor movement across mixed-DPI screens
display_dpi_scaling.deterministic_seam: Tauri window scale-change event injector verifying coordinate transforms and physical bounds calculations
display_dpi_scaling.validation_criteria: Overlay window maintains crisp particle rendering and correct click-through without coordinate clipping

permission_revocation.description: Microphone permission granted during onboarding then revoked via OS System Settings during runtime
permission_revocation.deterministic_seam: OS permission provider abstraction with mockable authorization status (granted, denied, restricted)
permission_revocation.validation_criteria: Runtime transitions cleanly from listening to attention state with localized permission recovery prompt
